question: Can even immense material wealth justify giving away this kaula teaching?
premises: Wealth could fill an ocean with jewels
Such wealth is compared to the teaching
inference: Even one who could fill the ocean with jewels should not trade this teaching for wealth.
uncertainties: The fused form ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is read as ratnasaṃpūrṇam akartuṃ/karotuṃ contextually unclear.
plain_english: Even if one had the means to fill the ocean with jewels.
